about: Fallback for src/sources/growthepie.js: normalized growthepie parts (https://www.growthepie.com, chain-level Basic tier; attribution required). Regenerate with node scripts/update-growthepie-fallback.mjs. Histories trimmed to the last 30 days.

ethereum.name: Ethereum Mainnet
ethereum.description: Ethereum, proposed by Vitalik Buterin in 2013 and launched in 2015, is the most decentralized and trusted smart contract platform to date.

arbitrum.name: Arbitrum One
arbitrum.description: Arbitrum One is developed by Offchain Labs. It uses an optimistic rollup approach and is fully EVM compatible, making it developer-friendly.

arbitrum_nova.name: Arbitrum Nova
arbitrum_nova.description: Arbitrum Nova is an Optimium developed by Offchain using AnyTrust protocol. As part of the Nitro stack Arbitrum Nova is fully EVM compatible.

base.name: Base
base.description: Base is an Ethereum Layer 2 offering a secure, low-cost, builder-friendly way for anyone, anywhere, to build onchain.

celo.name: Celo
celo.description: Mobile-first. Celo has the mission to build a regenerative digital economy that fosters prosperity for all. It migrated from being an L1 to an L2 in 2025.

fraxtal.name: Fraxtal
fraxtal.description: Fraxtal is an EVM equivalent Optimium utilizing the OP stack.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.description: Gravity is an Optimium built on the Orbit stack. It has its own gas token - G. A future migration to an L1 of the same name is planned.

ink.name: Ink
ink.description: Ink is an Ethereum OP Stack layer 2 blockchain designed to be the house of DeFi for the Superchain.

linea.name: Linea
linea.description: Linea is a developer-friendly ZK Rollup by ConsenSys, enhancing Ethereum by enabling a new wave of decentralized applications.

lisk.name: Lisk
lisk.description: Lisk is developed by the Onchain Foundation. It runs on the OP Stack as an EVM‑equivalent Layer 2 with low‑cost, scalable transactions for builders.

manta.name: Manta Pacific
manta.description: Manta Pacific is an Optimium empowering EVM-native zero-knowledge (ZK) applications and general dapps.

mantle.name: Mantle
mantle.description: Mantle is a modular ZK rollup built on the OP Stack with OP Succinct (SP1) ZK validity proofs. Public launch was in July 2023.

megaeth.name: MegaETH
megaeth.description: MegaETH is a real-time blockchain. Where crypto applications leverage extreme performance to reach their full potential.

metis.name: Metis
metis.description: Metis Andromeda is an EVM equivalent Optimium. Public launch was in November 2021.

mode.name: Mode Network
mode.description: Mode is an Optimistic Rollup and part of the Superchain.

optimism.name: OP Mainnet
optimism.description: OP Mainnet uses an optimistic rollup approach and is one of the oldest rollups. It is fully EVM compatible and it's tech-stack is widely used.

polygon_pos.name: Polygon PoS
polygon_pos.description: Polygon Proof-of-Stake is an EVM sidechain for Ethereum, planning to become a Validium. The bridge is validated by Polygon validators.

robinhood.name: Robinhood Chain
robinhood.description: Robinhood Chain is an Arbitrum Orbit Layer 2 built for financial services and tokenized real-world assets.

ronin.name: Ronin
ronin.description: Ronin is a blockchain designed for gaming and digital assets, providing fast and low-cost transactions.

scroll.name: Scroll
scroll.description: Scroll is a general purpose zkEVM rollup. Public launch was in October 2023.

soneium.name: Soneium
soneium.description: We dream of an open internet that transcends cultural differences and brings together people with diverse values.

starknet.name: Starknet
starknet.description: Starknet is a ZK Rollup developed by Starkware. It uses it's own programming language and general purpose virtual machine (Cairo VM).

taiko.name: Taiko Alethia
taiko.description: Taiko Alethia is a based, general purpose type-1 zk-rollup built to scale Ethereum without compromising decentralization.

unichain.name: Unichain
unichain.description: A Layer 2 sepcifically designed to be the home for DeFi and the home for multichain liquidity.

worldchain.name: World Chain
worldchain.description: World Chain is an OP Stack Rollup built to scale Proof of Personhood, aiming to offer priority blockspace for users with a World ID.

zksync_era.name: ZKsync Era
zksync_era.description: ZKsync Era uses ZK tech, aiming to boost throughput while preserving Ethereum's core values: freedom, self-sovereignty, and decentralization.

events.title: Genesis Block
events.description: The Ethereum genesis block was mined. The start of the network.

events.title: Homestead Upgrade
events.description: The Homestead upgrade lead to a slight reduction in block times.

events.title: Anomaly
events.description: A series of Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks targeted the Ethereum network which led to a temporary increase in block time.

events.title: Difficulty Bomb Activates
events.description: Difficulty bomb activates slowing block times.

events.title: Byzantium - Reduce Issuance and Difficulty Bomb Delay
events.description: Byzantium upgrade includes a reduction of block rewards from 5 ETH to 3 ETH and delays difficulty bomb.

events.title: Difficulty Bomb Activates
events.description: Difficulty bomb reactivates slowing block times.

events.title: Constantinople - Reduce Issuance and Difficulty Bomb Delay
events.description: Constantinople upgrade reduces block reward from 3 ETH to 2 ETH and delays difficulty bomb.

events.title: Difficulty Bomb Activates
events.description: Difficulty bomb reactivates slowing block times.

events.title: Difficulty Bomb Activates
events.description: Muir Glacier upgrade delayed difficulty bomb.

events.title: Serenity Phase 0
events.description: Serenity Phase 0 deployment increased issuance to secure the Beacon Chain a separate Proof-of-Stake network running in parallel to Ethereum's Proof-of-Work (PoW)

events.title: London Burn EIP-1559
events.issuance: 2 ETH per Block + PoS issuance + Fee Burn
events.description: London upgrade introduced EIP-1559 a mechanism to burn a portion of transaction fees. Ultra sound money is born.

events.title: Paris The Merge
events.description: Paris upgrade introduced the Merge - a transition from PoW to PoS by merging the main Ethereum chain with the Beacon Chain. This event permanently reduced ETH issuance by approximately 90%.

events.title: Shanghai-Capella (Shapella)
events.description: Shapella introduces various Staking improvements like enabling withdrawals.

events.title: Prague-Electra (Pectra)
events.description: Pectra increases Blob Target and brings UX improvements with native Account Abstraction

events.title: Fulu-Osaka (Fusaka)
events.description: Major improvements to Ethereum's scalability and user experience, including PeerDAS for enhanced data availability.
